teaser: You set the folded plans on the counter before the ink dries, already pacing off where the wall will need to go. That is life path 22, the Master Builder, meeting an ENTJ, the Commander. Both are suited to scale — the number toward something built to outlast you, the letters toward reaching the end result and making it real. What is particular here is how little patience either one has for the small, interim version of a thing. The sketch wants to be the building. The idea wants to be the company. That hurry is the whole crossing, gift and cost bundled into the same push.
excerpt: Midnight, and the laundromat is empty except for you, folding towels because the washer at home is still broken and fixing it keeps losing to larger plans.
